1.text: About what are they asking one another?

3.text: That over which they are in disagreement.

4.text: No! They are going to know.

5.text: Then, no! They are going to know.

6.text: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

7.text: And the mountains as stakes?<sup foot_note="228146">1</sup>

footnotes.228146: - To stabilize the land and balance the earth.

8.text: And We created you in pairs

9.text: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

10.text: And made the night as clothing<sup foot_note="228147">1</sup>

footnotes.228147: - Covering you in darkness and providing rest.

11.text: And made the day for livelihood

12.text: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]

14.text: And sent down from the rain clouds pouring water

15.text: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation

17.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

18.text: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

19.text: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways

20.text: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

21.text: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

22.text: For the transgressors, a place of return,

23.text: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

24.text: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.

footnotes.228148: - In proportion to and comparable with their crimes.

27.text: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

28.text: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

29.text: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

30.text: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."<sup foot_note="228149">1</sup>

footnotes.228149: - This announcement will be made to the companions of Hell.

31.text: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment<sup foot_note="228150">1</sup> -

footnotes.228150: - Of security, success and reward, including escape and safety from Hell.

33.text: And young women [companions] of equal age.

footnotes.228151: - Of wine which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

35.text: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

36.text: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,<sup foot_note="228152">1</sup>

footnotes.228152: - i.e., as a result of both their own righteous deeds and the limitless generosity of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) . Another meaning is "a gift calculated [to be adequate]."

37.text: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.<sup foot_note="228153">1</sup>

footnotes.228153: - None of Allāh's creatures can plead with Him on the Day of Judgement except by His permission.

38.text: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

39.text: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.<sup foot_note="228154">1</sup>

footnotes.228154: - i.e., a direct route through correct beliefs and righteous deeds.

40.text: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth<sup foot_note="228155">1</sup> and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"

footnotes.228155: - i.e., the deeds he did in this world, which await him in the Hereafter.
